purpose: Demonstrate a governed knowledge-assistance pattern that publishes source-grounded answers, exposes source conflicts and expiration, withholds unsupported answers, and creates accountable knowledge-maintenance work.
verified_operating_behaviors: three source-ready answers separated from three knowledge exceptions
conflicting sources require a controlling-source decision or withheld answer
expired guidance is never published as current instruction
missing policy coverage creates a knowledge-gap review instead of an inferred answer
publication blocked until all required controls are satisfied
final output separates publishable answers from withheld answers and maintenance work
reset restores a clean starting state
public maturity and non-claim boundary remains visible

acceptance.execution: Portfolio CI executes the Playwright suite across configured desktop, tablet, and mobile projects.

production_adaptation_requires: approved knowledge repositories and source owners
document status version and effective-date controls
baseline question volume search effort and correction measures
acceptance criteria regression tests and audit history
user training administrator ownership and content-refresh process
not_claimed: measured client productivity or cost savings
autonomous permission decisions or publication of unsupported answers
